assumptions: The webhook fires when a conversation state changes to closed and includes a conversation ID.
Intercom's conversation messages endpoint supports pagination via "cursor" or "per_page" parameters to fetch the full transcript.
Message bodies are plain text or markdown; Notion rich-text blocks will accept raw text content.
Email and phone number patterns follow standard formats (e.g., email: local@domain.tld, phone: digits with optional +/()-).
The Notion integration has permission to create/update pages and append rich-text blocks.
Redaction regexes are applied to the entire message body string, not just specific fields.

conversation_message.body: Hi team, please review the attached files. Contact me at john@example.com or +1-555-123-4567.

notes: Webhook payload includes conversation ID and state; trigger when state=closed.
Message body may be plain text or HTML depending on API version; v2.15+ returns plain text.
No authentication needed on webhook receiver side; secure via signature validation (not covered here).

conversation_messages.body: I need help with billing. My email is user@example.com and phone is 555-123-4567.

notes: Pagination via cursor using starting_after parameter; stop when pages.next is null.
Requires bearer token from INTERCOM_ACCESS_TOKEN env var.
Endpoint returns conversation message parts; use to reconstruct full transcript.
